title: Model-Year Allowance on the Comprehensive Deductible — Uploaded Binder Re-Review, Collateral Protection Insurance
content:
In the re-review of an uploaded binder under Collateral Protection Insurance on a closed tracking record, the ceiling for the proof's comprehensive deductible is raised by a model-year allowance. The model year is the model year of the financed vehicle on the borrower's Retail Installment Contracts record.

| Model year of the financed vehicle | Raise to the comprehensive deductible ceiling |
|---|---|
| 2017 or earlier | USD 500.00 |
| after 2017 and no later than 2020 (2018, 2019 or 2020) | USD 250.00 |
| later than 2020 | USD 0.00 |

## Boundaries

- Model year 2017: USD 500.00. Model year 2018: USD 250.00.
- Model year 2020: USD 250.00. Model year 2021: an allowance of USD 0.00.

The allowance applies to the comprehensive deductible only; it does not raise the collision deductible's ceiling.

**Hypothetical:** with a hypothetical plan ceiling of USD 800.00, a financed vehicle of model year 2016 raises the comprehensive deductible ceiling by USD 500.00, from USD 800.00 to USD 1300.00, while a vehicle of model year 2019 raises it by USD 250.00, to USD 1050.00.
